sources.title: Indiana Election Division, certified 2024 General Election results archive (ENR), office category 1005 JSON with county breakdown (settings: Certified=T)
Indiana Election Division, 2024 General Election results archive

method: pipeline/patches/2024_IN_HOUSE_monroe.py (via _in_enr.py) takes the Monroe County entry of every U.S. House district race that includes Monroe (only the 9th District) from the certified JSON. Party D is dem, R is rep, and Libertarian, independent and write-in candidates are oth.
validation: Monroe 18105 = official county totals dem 35,174 / rep 21,640 / oth 1,477 (MIT had only dem 9,811 / rep 4,994). Certified statewide (all 9 districts): dem 1,103,484 / rep 1,668,618. With this fill, the MIT-based state total is dem 1,181,006 (+7.0%) / rep 1,767,087 (+5.9%). The excess is outside Monroe: MIT counts Hendricks (18063) and St. Joseph (18141) twice, and Marshall (18099) and Warrick (18173) are slightly short.
